labelled_by: the author of this repository, who has not worked in restoration
protocol: Every job in data/jobs is invented. The labels below are what a careful reviewer should raise on those jobs, written by reading each job against the synthetic rule pack rather than by reading the detector output. A label with rule_id "none" describes a finding no rule in the pack can produce; it is counted as a false negative on purpose. A finding matches a label when job_id, detector, area_id, rule_id and target are all equal.
caveat: The same person wrote the detectors and these labels, and the set is far too small to estimate precision or recall reliably. Read the counts, not the ratios.
